features.title: Engine sync mechanism with braga-3d
features.user_visible_behavior: Engine fixes can be ported from braga-3d in one documented step.
verification: node scripts/sync-engine.mjs --dry-run prints the 3-way table; scripts/engine-base.json records the base
evidence: scripts/sync-engine.mjs + scripts/engine-base.json (base 1784ff3); dry run against braga-3d and, read-only, against porto-3d (session 008)
features.notes: Hash-guarded 3-way sync ported from guimaraes-3d. Report-only by default; --apply copies only behind files and writes *.conflict for diverged ones; --record advances the base. The older sync-engine.sh compared braga HEAD only and would have overwritten fork edits.
